witnesses.retain-current-classifier: plain text remains an unquoted YAML scalar
witnesses.extend-lowercase-catalog: empty and True remain outside the partial catalog
witnesses.leave-plain-unquoted: empty and plain text are not serialized strings
witnesses.quote-without-escaping: embedded quote produces an invalid representation
witnesses.escape-quotes-only: backslash is not preserved by the representation
witnesses.leave-controls-raw: newline remains raw instead of JSON escaped
witnesses.quote-title-only: author, publisher and note remain unquoted
witnesses.coerce-typed-spellings: True is changed to true instead of preserved
witnesses.accept-one-binary: bilateral public control requires both identified products
